name: MareQuest: An Interactive Tail
source:
A terrible darkness threatens a world of overwhelmingly adorable mares. Can a new cute mare with amnesia save the world or will she lose more than her memories along the way?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2391870/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
可怕的黑暗威胁着可爱母马的世界。一匹新的可爱的失忆母马能否拯救世界，还是她会失去更多的记忆？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2391870/]Steam[/url]]
